items.title: Fred Wesley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 21, 2024
items.q: When I was with Basie’s band the band... I joined, I’d been with them for a year. In that year we did every music festival in the world

ctx.x: Because their ears had been developed to that point.

You could really tell by my playing. You know? I can memorize stuff better than I can read music you know? I did jobs where I would have to read music. In fact I don’t take jobs where I have to read music now because I don’t read that well. I never read that well you know. I used to play, we’d play American Idol and with Count Basie, and you know you had to read music to do that, but you had to feel what the band was doing. You would have to feel that music rather than read it all the time. Sometimes you had to…
Yeah. I remember looking at your sort of chronology and thinking after all those years of playing in funk bands did you have to sort of re-set when you got with Basie and like remember how to swing?
